major_cooldowns.name: Invoke Xuen, the White Tiger
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Summon Xuen early in the opener so you can immediately channel into your burst sequence, then sync trinkets, potions, and stat buffs to its window; plan ahead so you are not wasting a global summoning him when you want to be dealing damage.

major_cooldowns.name: Zenith
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use this flexible-cooldown burst window during Invoke Xuen and Bloodlust to accelerate your cooldowns coming back; it has two charges so plan its use for the best moment rather than pressing on sight.

major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast during Zenith and stagger it between Strike of the Windlord and Whirling Dragon Punch so the Heart of the Jade Serpent buffs stack rather than overwrite each other; avoid casting it while you still hold the buff from those abilities.

major_cooldowns.name: Strike of the Windlord
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press on cooldown inside your Zenith/Xuen burst window as a primary damage source and to feed the Heart of the Jade Serpent buff, staggered against Whirling Dragon Punch and Celestial Conduit.

major_cooldowns.name: Touch of Death
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use it as soon as it is available and you have space to press it without delaying another ability; it no longer grants a damage buff in Midnight, so do not hold it except to catch the small execute window where the target has less health than your maximum.

defensives.name: Touch of Karma
defensives.usage_rule: Use first and foremost to absorb a known incoming damage spike; the absorbed damage is redirected to the target, so press it on cooldown into damage whenever the defensive value is not strictly needed.

defensives.name: Fortifying Brew
defensives.usage_rule: Press before heavy incoming damage; because it raises maximum health it also boosts Touch of Death and Touch of Karma, so cast it before either when you can to gain both the defensive and offensive benefit.

defensives.name: Dampen Harm
defensives.usage_rule: Use ahead of large hits to reduce high-damage attacks by up to 50%; best against big single blows rather than steady chip damage.

defensives.name: Diffuse Magic
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before a burst of magic damage to cut it by 60% and clear harmful magical debuffs back to their caster.

rules.description: Never repeat the same ability twice in a row
rules.action: Always alternate abilities to keep your Combo Strikes mastery active; track the last-pressed-button buff and never hit the same ability on back-to-back globals, as repeating breaks your core mastery damage.

rules.description: Open by chaining Xuen into your burst window
rules.action: Build to 4 Chi with Tiger Palm, summon Invoke Xuen, then fire potions, trinkets, and stat buffs before pressing Zenith, and chain Strike of the Windlord, Whirling Dragon Punch, and Celestial Conduit immediately afterward.
Always cast Celestial Conduit inside an active Zenith window so its Heart of the Jade Serpent stacks with your burst; using it outside Zenith wastes its strongest effect.

rules.description: Channel into Xuen, do not waste the summon
rules.action: Treat Invoke Xuen as a setup button and immediately follow the summon with your hardest-hitting abilities; do not summon Xuen on a global where you would rather be dealing damage, and avoid deviating from the opener sequence even mid-fight.

rules.description: Stagger Strike, Whirling Punch, and Conduit
rules.action: Space Strike of the Windlord, Whirling Dragon Punch, and Celestial Conduit apart so each refreshes the Heart of the Jade Serpent buff in turn; never cast one while you still hold the buff from another or you overwrite and lose uptime.

rules.description: Spend free Tiger Palm under Zenith to recycle Chi
rules.action: While Zenith is active your Chi spenders cost 1 less, so lean on Tiger Palm as your primary filler to pull Fists of Fury and Rising Sun Kick back from cooldown faster, but watch Chi so you do not overcap.

Keep Energy and Chi flowing by spending before either resource caps; build Chi with Tiger Palm when low and dump it on Fists of Fury, Rising Sun Kick, and Blackout Kick rather than sitting on a full bar.

rules.description: Stay in melee for Fists of Fury channel
rules.action: Remain in melee range and stationary through the Fists of Fury channel to land its full damage; reposition between channels rather than clipping it, and note Zenith can be cast during the channel without interrupting it.

source_summary: Windwalker Monk concentrates its damage inside a recurring burst window built around Invoke Xuen and the flexible-cooldown Zenith, lining both up with Bloodlust, potions, and trinkets. Celestial Conduit, Strike of the Windlord, and Whirling Dragon Punch are staggered inside that window so their shared Heart of the Jade Serpent buff stacks instead of overwriting. Between windows the spec is a Combo Strikes priority list: never repeat an ability, never overcap Energy or Chi, and keep short-cooldown abilities rolling so they are ready for the next burst.
